svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Order lifecycle subtitle: "UML state machine: transitions read event [guard] / action" kind: state # Top to bottom: left to right, seven states with long transition labels make a strip. direction: down # One port per transition, as UML draws them; a self-transition then keeps the top of its state. layout: { merge: false, spacing: 0.9 } # The happy path runs down the left; align sets each way out beside the state it leaves, so the # cancelled order turns right at Created and a refund sits beside Delivered. nodes: start: { shape: initial } created: { shape: state, label: Created } paid: { shape: state, label: Paid } packed: { shape: state, label: Packed } shipped: { shape: state, label: Shipped } delivered: { shape: state, label: Delivered } cancelled: { shape: state, label: Cancelled, align: created } refunded: { shape: state, label: Refunded, align: delivered } end: { shape: final } closed: { shape: final, align: cancelled } edges: - start -> created - created -> paid: "pay [card ok] / charge" - created -> created: "edit / recalc total" - created -> cancelled: "cancel / release stock" - paid -> packed: "pick / print label" - paid -> refunded: "cancel [not packed] / refund" - packed -> shipped: "hand over / send tracking" - shipped -> delivered: "deliver / notify buyer" - delivered -> refunded: "return [within 30 days] / refund" - delivered -> end - cancelled -> closed - refunded -> end

svg.title: Order lifecycle
svg.desc: Order lifecycle. 10 components. Connections: to Created; Created to Paid (pay [card ok] / charge); Created to Created (edit / recalc total); Created to Cancelled (cancel / release stock); Paid to Packed (pick / print label); Paid to Refunded (cancel [not packed] / refund); Packed to Shipped (hand over / send tracking); Shipped to Delivered (deliver / notify buyer); Delivered to Refunded (return [within 30 days] / refund); Delivered to ; Cancelled to ; Refunded to .

text.tspan: UML state machine: transitions read event [guard] / action
